confidence.notes: Verified on hardware (firmware 1930, part 006-B3110-00): the wrist cartography renders correctly and legibly, and coexists with the factory map. GarminDevice.xml advertises Garmin/CustomMaps and Garmin/BirdsEye. NOT measured: maxImgBytes, maxTilesPerMapset, and whether DEM shaded relief actually renders on this generation. The 20 MB limit often quoted for fenix devices is fenix 3-era and does not apply here. Custom Map raster limits are community figures, NOT measured here and NOT published by Garmin (whose own documentation was unreachable): 100 tiles across all KMZ files on the device and 1 megapixel per tile. The 500-tile allowance is reported only for Montana, Oregon 6x0 and GPSMAP 64, which this is not, so 100 is the safe figure. Unverified on hardware -- see docs/device-verification.md I. USB mode: mounts as a USB drive -- measured, in the sense that this project read its GarminDevice.xml off the mounted volume, which is not possible over MTP.
